description: Finnish postmortem background-context model. This file supplies population context only when no Finland-specific death-pathway reconstruction is available; it never infers an individual diagnosis or changes the realized cause of death.

rules.title: AGE-RELATED DEMENTIA CONTEXT
rules.basis: Alzheimer Europe 2025 age- and sex-specific dementia prevalence estimates for Europe, shown only when the realized Finnish ICD cause stack itself establishes dementia/Alzheimer disease. Vantaa 85+ is retained separately as an observed Finnish oldest-old cohort benchmark and is never averaged with the Europe estimate.
rules.limitations: Population prevalence benchmarks are context only: not annual incidence, not a Mortality Roulette modeled probability, and not a probability that dementia caused the realized death. When the realized ICD code itself establishes dementia/Alzheimer disease, condition status is PRESENT/YES rather than a prevalence-derived probability.

provenance.source: The Prevalence of Dementia in Europe 2025

additional_benchmarks.label: VANTAA 85+
additional_benchmarks.population: Vantaa residents age 85+ in 1991; both sexes
additional_benchmarks.status: observed cohort benchmark; not a modeled probability

provenance.source: Prediction models for dementia and neuropathology in the oldest old: the Vantaa 85+ cohort study
